gaps.explanation: Statement of Activities and Governmental Funds Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances and Net Position - Cash Basis (p2) prints 10 columns; detail[] has schedules for General (p3), Street (p4), Fire and EMS (p5) and New 1/2 Cent Sales Tax (p6) only. Check: 6,837,141 + 1,734,063 = 8,571,204 = statement total.
